title: A spend logged after an "available" check on the same day (decision J3)
story: One bank, set up Fri 20 Nov 2026 with 300,000. On Sat 21 Nov a debit card buy of 10,000; the bank posts it on Tue 24 Nov. On Sun 22 Nov a coffee of 500 is paid by debit card and logged at 08:00 (it also posts on the 24th). At 09:00 the person checks the bank app's available figure: 289,500, with both pending debits already off. At 12:00 a lunch of 1,200 is logged. J3: an available check holds the events dated before its day and those on its day told before it; a spend told after the check is after it, whatever the check kind. So the coffee is inside the check and the lunch comes off after it. No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.
